mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in any economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, it indicates a deteriorating labor market and economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending supply shock that increases inflation and prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO decline signal in late-cycle is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days in any economic regime.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.2%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.2%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicates a strong supply-demand balance, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery regimes, a rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) signals improving consumer confidence and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of post-recession recovery periods, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
